notes.title: Localization Update!!!
notes.content:
Hey Monsterz!

It’s been an incredible ride since launch, and we’re thrilled to see all the chaos, laughter, and epic moments you’ve shared so far. Your feedback has been invaluable, and we’ve been working hard to bring some much-needed improvements and updates. Here’s what’s new and what’s coming next!

[h3]Localization Updates[/h3]
We’re expanding the Bum Bum world!

Supported Languages (90% Complete):

🇹🇷 Turkish  
🇫🇷 French  
🇮🇹 Italian  
🇩🇪 German  
🇪🇸 Spanish

There are still a few hiccups here and there, and we’re actively squashing these issues. If you encounter any missing or awkward translations, please let us know – your feedback helps us improve!

Upcoming Languages:

🇵🇱 Polish  
🇷🇺 Russian 
🇨🇳 Simplified Chinese 
🇰🇷 Korean 
🇧🇷 Brazilian Portuguese 
🇯🇵 Japanese

Work is well underway, and we’ll keep you posted as these roll out.

[h3]UI Overhaul[/h3]
We’ve polished the game’s user interface to improve your experience. From cleaner menus to smoother navigation, we’ve made sure everything feels snappier, more intuitive, and easier to use.

[h3]New Video Settings – Take Control![/h3]
By popular demand, we’ve added resolution settings to the video options. Whether you’re aiming for high performance or crisp visuals, you can now customize your gameplay experience.

[h3]Mini-Game Updates[/h3]
We’ve given several mini-games a visual and mechanical facelift!

[b]Improved Graphics:[/b] More vibrant visuals and polished animations for a smoother and more engaging experience.
[b]Refined Mechanics:[/b] Based on your feedback, we’ve fine-tuned certain mechanics to make the gameplay tighter and even more fun!

Let us know what you think of the changes – your input is key!

[h3]Network Improvements[/h3]
We’ve worked behind the scenes to enhance network stability and reduce lag during matches. You should notice smoother online gameplay, better connectivity, and fewer interruptions.

[h3]Keep the Feedback Coming![/h3]
Your feedback is what drives these updates forward. Whether it’s bugs, suggestions, or ideas for new content, we’re all ears! Share your thoughts on the Steam forums, Discord, or in-game channels.

This is just the beginning! We’ve got even more exciting updates planned, so stay tuned. In the meantime, keep slapping, smashing, and causing chaos – we’ll see you in the arena!

Until next time, Monsterz – keep the fun alive! 🎮

Discord: https://discord.gg/ZRZFPk4NMt

notes.title: We’re LIVE and All Ears!
notes.content:
The wait is over – Bum Bum Monsterz is officially live! We couldn’t be more excited to see all of you diving into the chaotic fun. Your feedback has been incredible, and we’re listening closely to every suggestion, bug report, and idea you’ve shared. This is just the beginning, and here’s what’s coming next:

[h2]Hotfixes Incoming![/h2]
We’re hard at work squashing bugs and fine-tuning the game based on your input. Expect hotfixes to roll out soon, addressing performance issues, gameplay balancing, and quality-of-life improvements. Keep those reports coming – you’re helping us make the game better for everyone!

[h2]More Customization & a New Game Mode[/h2]
We know you love expressing yourselves, so we’re expanding customization options! From quirky new skins to fresh accessories, get ready to add even more personality to your Monsters.

Oh, and did we mention? A brand-new game mode is in the works! We’re keeping the details under wraps for now, but we can promise it’ll bring a whole new level of chaos and strategy to the arena. Stay tuned!

[h2]Localization Expanding to 6 New Languages[/h2]
Our goal is to bring Bum Bum Monsterz to as many players as possible around the world. We’re currently working on localizing the game into:
🇫🇷 French
🇮🇹 Italian
🇩🇪 German
🇪🇸 Spanish
🇵🇹 Portuguese
🇹🇷 Turkish

These localizations are already in progress, and we’ll keep you updated as they roll out.

[h2]We’re All Ears[/h2]
Your feedback drives everything we do. Whether it’s gameplay suggestions, ideas for new content, or issues you’ve encountered, we want to hear from you! Share your thoughts in the Steam forums, social media, or directly through in-game channels.

Thank you for your amazing support so far. Together, we’ll make Bum Bum Monsterz even better. Keep smashing, slapping, and having a blast – we’ll see you in the arena!

Until next time, keep those feedbacks coming! 🎮

notes.title: Devlog #4 - Slap Arena: Score Big, Stun Hard!
notes.content:
Hey Monsters!

We’re pumped to introduce Slap Arena, a chaotic, slap-filled mode where every hit counts in a no-holds-barred showdown! Whether you’re here to slap your rivals senseless or strategize for that perfect knockout, this mode is packed with action for all!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277231/206f8321b68162c3c6448459af8d2c13f9bbe770.png[/img]

[h2]What’s the Goal?[/h2]

Simple: stun and score! Rack up points by landing slaps on the opposing team. Every stun equals a point, and the team with the most points when the timer ends takes the win. But if it’s a tie, brace yourself for a sudden-death!

[h2]How It Works?[/h2]

Each match pits two teams (2v2, 3v3, or 4v4) against each other in a slap-happy battle in the ring. Players spawn from opposite corners – red and blue – and as soon as the timer starts, it’s game on! Every successful slap on an opponent stuns them and earns your team a point. Work together, protect your teammates, and land those slaps!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277231/b1da6724799f51b8c8229355c74036d471bcff4d.png[/img]

[h2]Game Mechanics Overview[/h2]

[b]Teams:[/b] 2v2, 3v3, or 4v4 – assemble your squad and enter the ring!

[b]Controls:[/b] Move with “WASD,” jump with “Space,” and slap with “Mouse Left.” Team up, coordinate, and get ready to rack up the points! But of course use of a gamepad is encouraged.

[b]Stun Points:[/b] Each slap stuns your opponent and adds +1 to your team’s score. 

[h2]Power-Ups & Mystery Boxes[/h2]

Look out for mystery boxes that spawn around the arena. Each box gives unique boosts, from Belly Dash (stuns everyone in your way) to Steel Butt (immunity to stuns). But be careful – some moves can backfire, like stunning your own teammates and accidentally scoring for the other team!

[b]Belly Dash:[/b] Stunning everyone, friend or foe – just make sure to aim right, or you’ll give the other team points!

[b]Steel Butt:[/b] Grants immunity from slaps. Use it to get in close and mess with the opponents without getting stunned!

[b]Freeze:[/b] Frozen players can still be slapped, but they won’t get stunned, adding a twist to your team’s strategy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277231/6163c1a9de389f3a04f7bd4f480b5afb529e66c0.png[/img]

[h2]Scoreboard & Sudden Death[/h2]

Our Slap Arena scoreboard tracks every slap and point! The UI shows the score, timer, and which team’s leading. If the timer ends in a tie, the sudden death rule kicks in: the next slap to stun an opponent wins the game!

So gather your team, aim those slaps, and step into the Slap Arena! We can’t wait to see which team will dominate the ring and claim victory.

Until next time, happy slapping!

notes.title: Devlog #3 - Hot Potato Frenzy
notes.content:
Hey Monsters!

Get ready to turn up the heat in "Hot Potato," the mode that will keep you on your toes from start to explosive finish! Brace yourselves, because it's all about passing the ticking bomb to your opponents before it blows – a battle of wits, timing, and sheer chaos!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277231/206f8321b68162c3c6448459af8d2c13f9bbe770.png[/img]

[h2]What’s the Goal?[/h2]

Easy enough: don’t let the bomb blow up on you! The clock is ticking, and the bomb keeps passing hands. Outplay your rivals and pass that bomb at the right moment. Think you can handle the heat? Let’s find out!

[h2]How It Works?[/h2]

Each match begins with two teams, anywhere from 2v2 to 4v4. As soon as the game starts, a player is randomly chosen to hold the bomb, which is set to detonate in a short countdown. Use your movement, dodge skills, and quick strikes to pass the bomb to a rival. Hit your opponents with a slap to transfer the bomb to them, but be careful – get stunned if they hit you back!

And if the bomb timer ends while it’s still in your hands… BOOM! Opposing team scores!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277231/98db6b310ba72262cf2bb0be20431e1ce2282605.png[/img]

[h2]Game Mechanics Overview[/h2]

[b]Teams:[/b] 2v2, 3v3, or 4v4 – choose your squad and jump into the action!

[b]Controls:[/b] Move with “WASD,” jump with “Space,” and hit with “Mouse Left.” Quick reactions and precise timing are key to surviving this intense mode. But of course use of a gamepad is encouraged.

[b]Bomb Transfer:[/b] The bomb will explode every 15 seconds unless you pass it to an opponent in time. Hitting an opponent stuns them briefly, giving you a moment to escape!

[b]Stunning Moves:[/b] When you hit an opponent, they’re stunned. Use this time to make your move – or pass the bomb!

[h2]Map & Design Details[/h2]

This isn’t your average playing field! Our maps come with rotating obstacles, punch walls, conveyor belts, and moving platforms. Each element is here to add extra layers of challenge. Keep your eyes open and strategize with your teammates to avoid getting caught – or to help your team pass the bomb just in time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277231/1613a39f1aa91da068f80995ad88fdf8e2aac913.png[/img]

[h3]Key Features:[/h3] 

• Punch Wall: Watch out for random punches that can knock you off your path! 
• Up/Down Column: Platforms rise and fall, creating unpredictable obstacles. 
• Conveyor Belt: The belt spins counterclockwise, so move wisely or be pushed toward unexpected dangers. 
• Rotation Mechanism: This spinning arm will knock you down if you’re not careful. Time your jumps, or risk getting thrown!

We designed Hot Potato to be a test of quick reflexes, strategy, and team synergy. Dodge, hit, pass, and survive – and may the best team win! We can’t wait to see you dive into the Hot Potato madness.

Until next time, keep dodging and stay explosive!

notes.title: Devlog #2 - The Chaos of Color Clash!
notes.content:
Hey Monsters!

We’re thrilled to introduce Color Clash, a vibrant, fast-paced mode designed to test your teamwork and paint-splashing skills in a 3-minute showdown! Whether you're a sneaky strategist or a paint-loving daredevil, this mode has something for everyone.

[h2]What’s the Goal?[/h2]

It’s simple: paint the most tiles! Grab your paint, claim tiles across the battlefield, and make sure your team holds onto them by the end of the round. Easy, right? Well, with rival players ready to swipe your colors and deplete your paint tanks, things get intense fast!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277231/206f8321b68162c3c6448459af8d2c13f9bbe770.png[/img]

[h2]How It Works?[/h2]

Each player starts with a tank (maybe a funky backpack or a fancy bucket!) to fill with paint. As you dash across the map, capture tiles for your team’s color. But here’s the twist: every tile you paint drains your tank, so you'll need to refill often. Find a refill station or, if you’re feeling bold, swipe paint directly from an opponent! And if both teams are neck and neck when the timer ends, get ready for a nail-biting overtime!

[h2]Game Mechanics Overview[/h2]

[b]Teams:[/b] 2v2, 3v3, or 4v4 – pick your squad and hit the ground running!

[b]Refill Stations:[/b] Scattered around the map, they’re your lifeline! Be fast because they’re limited and have a cooldown after use.

[b]Tile Takeover: [/b]Walk over neutral or rival tiles to make them yours. But watch out—if a rival player’s already on a tile, you can’t claim it until they step off. Timing is everything here!

[b]Stealing Paint:[/b] Out of paint? Sneak up on a rival, hit with a slap, and watch them lose their stash while you fill up!

[h2]Map & Design Details[/h2]

The map has plenty of space to cover. The arrangement of refill stations changes depending on team size, so keep your eyes peeled! Platforms also add a vertical twist, and falling off means you’ll respawn – fuel intact – but at the cost of precious time.

Get a peek to the map design steps from the images below. From pen and paper to full 3D...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277231/c9084e05d2773debf9d6d023adcbef45bd39e8af.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277231/903ee5afb4f5aca4d755844846a31c34c6ab669b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277231/896286b186de99e0c77f7320c8a38f014026fec3.jpg[/img]


We hope Color Clash brings out your inner artist – and maybe a bit of your sneaky side! Assemble your team, plan your strategy, and dive into the chaos. We can’t wait to see which team will claim the most tiles and emerge victorious!

Until next time, happy painting!

notes.title: Bum Bum Monsterz – FAQ
notes.content:
[h3]1. What the heck is Bum Bum Monsterz?![/h3]
Glad you asked! Bum Bum Monsterz is the ultimate, chaos-fueled party game where wild, bumbling monsters duke it out for glory, bragging rights, and maybe a snack. Think explosions, traps, and epic monster mayhem. It’s fast, ridiculous, and the most fun you can have while losing a few friends (temporarily).

[h3]2. Where can I play this monstrosity of a game?[/h3]
You’ll be unleashing your monster mayhem on PC, and if you humans go wild for it (which you will), who knows where else it might pop up? Consoles? Toasters? Calculators? Mars? We’re open to suggestions.

[h3]3. What’s the point of the game?[/h3]
The point? WIN. Destroy your opponents, complete challenges, cause as much chaos as possible, and look cool doing it.

[h3]4. Can I destroy my friends online?[/h3]
You bet! Bum Bum Monsterz features online multiplayer and even local multiplayer for those brave enough to trash-talk in person. Up to 8 players can join a match (4v4), so invite your squad or random strangers—just be prepared to laugh.

[h3]5. How many players can crash into one match?[/h3]
Eight glorious monsters, all brawling in a whirlwind of madness. The more, the merrier (and messier). But if you want to crush your friends in a 1v1 duel, you can do that too.

[h3]6. What are these “monsters” like?[/h3]
Oh, they’re not your typical spooky monsters. We’re talking weird, wacky, and wonderfully customizable. You get to deck out your monster with crazy skins, accessories, and ridiculous costumes.

[h3]7. What game modes are there?[/h3]
We’ve got modes for whatever chaos you crave, including:

• Slap Arena (4v4 slapdown! No rules, just madness.)
• Catch the Circle (You have to literally “jump through hoops” to win in this mode.)
• Color Clash (Paint the zone and hold it. Slap down the opposing force and dominate.)
• Volleymania (The name says it all—volleyball, but a little crazier.)
• Push the Ball (Experience what the Greek king Sisyphus felt. It’s...complicated.)
These are just the modes in the demo version of Bum Bum Monsterz, which you can download to duke it out with your friends. Many more will be available at launch.

[h3]8. Can I play by myself (if no one likes me)?[/h3]
There aren’t any solo modes or AI opponents to keep you company while you practice your chaotic skills just yet. But that might change in the future. Who needs friends when you’ve got exploding barrels, right?

[h3]9. Can I use my controller to cause mayhem?[/h3]
Absolutely! Controller support is fully baked in, so you can sit back and let the thumbsticks guide your path of destruction. Button-mashing has never been more satisfying.

[h3]10. What kind of PC do I need to run this madness?[/h3]
You won’t need a supercomputer to run Bum Bum Monsterz. It’s optimized for most decent PCs (even that ancient one you refuse to upgrade). Full system requirements coming soon!

[h3]11. Will there be more mayhem after launch?[/h3]
Oh, you bet! We’re planning on dropping new customization options, maps, and modes like hotcakes. Your appetite for fashion and chaos will always be satisfied.

[h3]12. Wait, are there microtransactions?![/h3]
Relax. At launch, there won’t be any microtransactions—just pure, unfiltered monster madness. Down the road, we might toss in some optional cosmetics so you can snazz up your monster, but it won’t affect gameplay. We’re not that evil.

[h3]13. When can I get my hands on this masterpiece?[/h3]
We’re targeting a very late 2024 or very early 2025 release. We know, the wait’s tough, but trust us—it’ll be worth it. In the meantime, follow us for updates so you don’t miss a beat!

[h3]14. How do I stay in the loop for all things Bum Bum Monsterz?[/h3]
Simple. Follow us on social media and join our discord for all the latest news, behind-the-scenes sneak peeks, and juicy reveals. Don’t miss out on the monster madness!

For more of the madness, take a gander at our linktree:
https://linktr.ee/bumbummonsterz

notes.title: Devlog #1: Jolly Cooperation
notes.content:
[h3]Hey guys and gals![/h3]

As the game’s still on the road to the full release, we wanted to share [b]a bit of behind-the-scene stuff[/b] with you and kickstart our devlog series, where we’ll explore different aspects of[b] Bum Bum Monsterzz[/b] production and what can you expect in the final game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277231/df4827a46e80c19bd72c35d136e11477004f8d6e.png[/img]
[i]Pictured above: the spirit of cooperation[/i]


Let’s kick it off with the single most important aspect of our game: [b]cooperation[/b]. As the name suggests, [b]Bum Bum Monsterzz[/b] are not lone wolves, so in order to achieve their goals they’ll need a companion or three. The game’s not simply about sucker-punching your opponents, no. It’s about sucker-punching your opponents, [b]together [/b]😍

Here’s how we foster the cooperative spirit based on the design of one of the game modes available to you: [b]“Push the Ball!”[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277231/cec03477b747ed3e915641a12cb85cbbefb9f839.png[/img]
[i]Not everything begins on a PC screen.[/i]


You and your party are tasked with [b]pushing a giant ball through an obstacle course[/b] to the finish line. It’s a task that’d Sisyphus blush by itself, but beware! Your efforts may be thwarted by your opponents, as both teams can sabotage each other by setting off traps, or making the obstacles more difficult to pass.

[b]This double-layered approach forces the players to coordinate their actions[/b] and sabotage the opposing team while keeping the ball rolling. Simple misunderstanding between the teammates may lead to the opposition coming out on top. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277231/92b51d715ccb043f5000e485ae8fc8a2878b296d.png[/img]
[i]Before...[/i]


We didn’t want to overwhelm the players, so despite the considerable depth of this mode, different challenges, modifiers, and [b]gameplay features are introduced one by one[/b] in separate phases. Each of them requires the players to switch up the tactics and adapt, while still cooperating. New challenges and obstacles are accompanied by new opportunities and power-ups such as speed boosts and sabotage immunity, keeping the gameplay fresh and engaging.

And while we love to see the glorious chaos erupt on screen whenever two teams compete, [b]our UI designers are working very hard to ensure that everything is clear [/b]and understandable to the players. We’re of the firm opinion that players losing the match because they comically bumped into each other in a moment of miscommunication is much funnier than those same players getting beaten because they had no idea what’s happening on screen ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44277231/79bbd6126786865470f368ed24fff29c1bceab87.png[/img]
[i]...and after![/i]


That’s just one example of a varied array of challenges awaiting you in the final version of the game. We hope you enjoy getting to know a bit more about our design philosophy and we’re hoping to share a bit more about the technical side of the production in the future devlogs, in the meantime:

[b]Party on! [/b]
